{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Padmefull2Parade.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] parade dress mimicked the petals of this flower.]]A [[Species/Legends|species]] of huge, lovely '''flowers''', grew near [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padme Amidala's]] [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|native village]] in the mountains of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Their petals moved through [[Color/Legends|shades]] of pink and yellow, and they bloomed only once every eighty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] thought this secular event heralded a time of special celebration.<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

During her tenure as [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], Amidala possessed a white dress that came with a cape of [[Silk/Legends|silky]] petals, which imitated those of that flower species. She wore it on at least one occasion, during the [[Freedom Day|victory celebrations]] that followed the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] demise<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
